rules.title: Silent k and w: knife, write, wrong
rules.short_explanation: At the start of a word, k before n (knife, know) and w before r (write, wrong) are not pronounced, but you must still write them. A silent w also appears in answer and sword.
rules.tts_text: Write the silent k in know and the silent w in write.
rules.mnemonic: Kn and wr: the first letter is silent, but still there.

rules.title: Silent b, g, h, t: doubt, sign, hour
rules.short_explanation: Some words contain letters you do not pronounce: b in doubt and climb, g in sign and foreign, h in hour and honest, t in listen and castle. Learn these words as whole shapes.
rules.tts_text: Some words keep a silent b, g, h or t, so learn them by sight.
rules.mnemonic: Climb the castle, listen to the honest sign.
